summary: Forest Service fire tower on Frosty Mountain, Dawson County, GA; a 1966 USGS visit found it, Forest Lookouts lists it as removed, and a July 2008 SummitPost caption says only concrete footings remained.

corrections.why: A July 2008 SummitPost caption says concrete footings remained on the summit. Footings only is the closer fit, and the record should keep the site note.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: WillhiteWeb says Frosty appears to be a sub-peak name on Amicalola Mountain. SummitPost says the summit of Amicalola Mountain is called Frosty Mountain. The story reports both views.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. No build year, staffing history or fire is in the sources read, and the removal date is unknown. The brief's coordinates (34.5965, -84.2265) and elevation were not checked. The SummitPost caption is dated only by a byline line (28 July 2008), read here as the posting date; no newer source was found. WillhiteWeb's 'Moved footing' caption is ambiguous and not used. AllTrails returned HTTP 403 and was not read. Access level 'public' rests on the trail passing over the summit; no closure notice was seen.
